# Harborline saved trips PRD

Harborline already sells single ferry tickets. This release adds saved trips. It is a fictional product used as a test fixture.

## Saved trips

A commuter saves a route and departure time once, then rebooks it with one tap from the home screen.

## Rebooking

Rebooking a saved trip shows the price and the next departure before payment, and confirms with a clear success state.
